decode.note: evidence class: published Sony formulae, not per-unit measured

provenance.built_from: direct re-measurement of the original camera files
provenance.legacy_dependency: none — legacy catalogues were read once to recover which source files existed, then discarded

categories.title: Normal daylight and interiors
categories.provokes: baseline drift — a look that misbehaves on ordinary material is disqualified
categories.rule: median linear luma between 0.02 and 1.0, little floor content, no blown highlights

categories.title: Deep underexposure
categories.provokes: black crush, hue shifts in the toe, noise lifted into visible colour
categories.rule: over 35% of pixels near the code floor, or median linear luma below 0.0015

categories.title: Overexposure and clipped highlights
categories.provokes: hard clipping, hue twist above white, loss of highlight separation
categories.rule: 95th-percentile linear luma above 1.5, or top code above 0.78

categories.title: Saturated practical lights and objects
categories.provokes: gamut collapse, channel clipping, hue rotation on out-of-gamut sources
categories.rule: over 2% of pixels outside Rec.709, or broad high-saturation coverage at high luma

categories.title: Low-saturation scenes
categories.provokes: false colour and tinting where there should be none; neutral-axis errors
categories.rule: median saturation below 0.25 and under 35% of pixels above 0.40 saturation

categories.title: Difficult shadows
categories.provokes: banding and gradient breakup where deep shadow meets a bright source
categories.rule: over 13 stops between the 5th and 99th luma percentile, with real floor content

categories.title: Motion and camera noise
categories.provokes: temporal instability — a look that flickers or amplifies grain frame to frame
categories.rule: frame-to-frame luma change above 0.9 relative, or dark-region noise above 0.12

categories.title: Skin under neutral light
categories.provokes: skin-tone accuracy on the reference case, with no colour cast to hide behind
categories.rule: a labelled face, with a near-neutral frame cast

categories.title: Skin under warm light
categories.provokes: warm-cast skin drifting orange or losing separation from the background
categories.rule: a labelled face, with a warm frame cast

categories.title: Skin under green light
categories.provokes: green-cast skin turning sallow; the hardest cast for a colour model
categories.rule: a labelled face, with a green frame cast

categories.title: Skin under mixed lighting
categories.provokes: competing sources pulling skin in two directions at once
categories.rule: a labelled face, with two or more disagreeing casts in frame
